Adoption: Includes the placement of a child with an Eligible Employee prior to the relevant government department seeking a permanent care order for the child.
Award: The Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020.
BPECC: Best Practice Employment Commitment Committee, established under clause 84.
FFPPOA: First full pay period on or after.
HSR: Health and safety representative (including a deputy health and safety representative).
Immediate Family: A Spouse, Child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of the Employee; or a child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of a Spouse of the Employee.
Miscarriage: A spontaneous loss of an embryo or fetus before a period of gestation of 20 weeks.
NES: National Employment Standards — Part 2-2 of the Fair Work Act 2009.
Registered Health Practitioner: An individual registered under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law to practise a health profession, other than as a student.
Spouse: A person to whom an Employee is married, a de facto partner, former spouse or former de facto spouse. A de facto Spouse means a person who lives with the Employee as husband, wife or same-sex partner on a bona fide domestic basis.
Stillborn Child: A child who weighs at least 400 grams at delivery or whose period of gestation was at least 20 weeks, who has not breathed since delivery, and whose heart has not beaten since delivery.
VHIA: Victorian Hospitals' Industrial Association — the employers' representative body.
WIC: Workplace Implementation Committee, established under subclause 83.2.
WIRC Act: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic), or where applicable the Accident Compensation Act 1985 (Vic) or the Workers Compensation Act 1958 (Vic).
